scripts.serve: node -e "import('node:http').then(({createServer})=>import('node:fs').then(fs=>import('node:path').then(path=>{const root=path.resolve('site');createServer((req,res)=>{let p=path.join(root,req.url==='/'?'index.html':decodeURIComponent(req.url.split('?')[0]));if(!p.startsWith(root)){res.statusCode=403;return res.end('Forbidden')}fs.readFile(p,(err,data)=>{if(err){res.statusCode=404;return res.end('Not Found')}const ext=path.extname(p);const map={'.html':'text/html; charset=utf-8','.json':'application/json; charset=utf-8','.js':'text/javascript; charset=utf-8','.css':'text/css; charset=utf-8','.mmd':'text/plain; charset=utf-8'};res.setHeader('Content-Type',map[ext]||'application/octet-stream');res.end(data)})}).listen(4173,()=>console.log('http://127.0.0.1:4173'))}))"
